title: Agent docs match the board: apricitus scope, generated CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md, no local paths
description:
`AGENTS.md` tells agents to use the commit scope `apricity-a1b2c3` and `CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md:88` says "Project key prefix: apricity", but `.kanbus.yml` sets `project_key: apricitus` and every commit uses `apricitus-…`. `CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md` (446 lines) is a rendered copy of `CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.template.md` (387 lines, Jinja placeholders at 88-102); both are committed with no generation script or CI check that they agree. `.gitignore` has redundant entries (`/samples/**/*.wav` duplicates the global `*.wav`; `project/.overlay/` appears twice).

Done when: both documents say `apricitus`; the rendered file is produced by a script and CI checks it is current; the machine-local paths are removed; the gitignore duplicates are gone.
